To overcome this bottleneck, we propose a novel approximation algorithm that does not optimize DP(𝑐) as existing approaches do. Instead, we introduce a new quadratic programming (QP) formulation for the 𝑐-biased DDS and theoretically prove that their optimal solutions are equivalent. Based on this, we design a FISTA-based DDS discovery algorithm that achieves a significant theoretical breakthrough over the SOTA algorithms [58, 74]. 5.1 From DP formulation to QP formulation In this section, we present the QP formulation of the 𝑐-biased DDS problem and prove its optimal equivalence to the original DP(𝑐) formulation.
